Hi Samantha / team — thanks for the questions. Quick responses below plus attachments and links. Happy to join the 3:30pm PT call to walk through samples if that still works.

SOC 2 / DPA / BAA:
- SOC 2: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type I and is mid-way through our Type II engagement; auditors have scheduled testing now with projected Type II report availability in Q3 2027. We can provide the SOC 2 Type I report and our SOC 2 readiness summary now (link below).
- GDPR / HIPAA: We provide a standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA) with GDPR commitments. We do offer a BAA for customers requiring HIPAA protections — please share Acme’s legal contact and we’ll route the BAA draft.

Audit logging capabilities (detailed):
- Admin activity logs: Captures user identity, role, action (create/delete/update), target resource, timestamp, IP address, and session id. Console actions and admin API calls are recorded.
- API request logs: We record request id, caller identity (API key/service account), path, method, response status, latency_ms, and a hashed response fingerprint for debug purposes (we avoid storing full PII by default; configurable fields can be included under agreed terms).
- Retention: Default retention is 90 days. Retention windows are configurable per customer up to 7 years for both admin and API logs (requires configured storage/export).
- Export: Logs can be exported on-demand or streamed continuously to a customer-owned S3 bucket in JSON or CSV format. We provide a managed export job in the Console and a Logs Export API (examples attached).
- Immutability / tamper-evidence: Exports are written to an append-only storage layer with SHA256 checksums per file and signed manifest metadata. For high-assurance needs we support WORM policies on the export bucket and signed audit manifests that make modifications detectable.

Attachments included: audit_log_sample.csv (two sample rows), security-whitepaper.pdf. Also sharing: https://redwood.ai/soc2-readiness-summary and https://redwood.ai/docs/audit-logging for API examples and export payload schema.

Recommended next steps:
1) I can walk through the sample logs and export workflow in the 3:30pm PT call.
2) If you want a custom retention/export workflow (e.g., daily S3 pushes + lifecycle), Ben and I can scope an implementation plan.

Let me know if you want me to redact/include additional fields in the sample export.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
